annotation.bound_parties_text: The rule binds persons operating unmanned aircraft in US airspace, persons producing standard remote identification unmanned aircraft and broadcast modules, and persons submitting means of compliance or declarations of compliance; it also sets duties for the FAA Administrator.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: after September 16, 2023, no person may operate an unmanned aircraft within the airspace of the United States unless the operation meets the requirements of § 89.110 or § 89.115.
annotation.dates_quote: Amdt. 89-1, 86 FR 4505, Jan. 15, 2021, unless otherwise noted. ... after September 16, 2023, no person may operate an unmanned aircraft
